question: Should this umbrella remain the canonical tracker for Linux companion parity, or should maintainers designate a narrower Linux companion issue tied to the current open implementation PRs?
rationale: Windows is now represented by a shipped Hub path, but Linux app architecture, packaging, security review, and parity scope still require maintainer intent before automation can safely act.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker until a Linux companion implementation lands or is explicitly descoped.

options.title: Split Linux Canonical
options.body: Create or designate a narrower Linux companion issue and link the open implementation PRs before retiring the umbrella.

options.title: Defer Native Linux
options.body: Record that native Linux companion parity is not planned for now and route experiments to external companion repositories.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker until a Linux companion implementation lands or is explicitly descoped.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the issue, gave the GTK-native direction, and is the clearest product-routing owner from the available history.
